paragraphs: Bivi bar Guzlan: Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia, chapter 2, halakhah 5.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia2:5 scalar has Bivi bar Guzlon (גוזלון). The supplied heading has Guzlan or Gula and the notice has Guzlan (גוזלן); retain both alternatives and the spelling difference. The compressed Huna/Bivi chain in the witness is not expanded into the notice or used to add a title to Bivi.
